# LocationProfile

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A named network location, such as `corporate`: every test must match
(#38). The agent evaluates the profiles when the network changes and on
every heartbeat, and scopes test the result with `location_profile`.

Appears at: `/policy/location_profiles`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | array of [`NetworkRef`](network-ref.md) | yes |  | 1 to 32 items | 1.0.0 | The tests, all of which must match. No `location_profile` tests. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | 1 to 64 characters | 1.0.0 | The profile's name: 1 to 64 characters, letters, digits, `_`, `.` or `-`. Compared without case. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
